environment.description: Same ECS Fargate deployment. ALB has AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet in default BLOCK mode with sensitivity level HIGH. Additionally, the RDS PostgreSQL instance has parameter group with 'log_statement=all' and the database role used by the application is configured with: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA inventory TO app_readonly; the JDBC_URL connects as app_readonly. The RDS instance also has IAM authentication enabled but the app uses password auth to the restricted role.

config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA inventory TO app_readonly
config.network: ALB public-facing, ECS task in private subnet, RDS in private subnet
